title: Good for Paperbacks and Photos
text: Good for Paperbacks and Photos. I bought six of these for my book collection, but the majority of my hardback books will not fit in them. They are great for paperback books, though, and craft pamphlets laid flat, so I am using them for that. They are also acid-free according to the sticker on the box, so I am planning to store my photos in them. So far they are the only good option I have found for my panoramic photos. The dividers don't stay in place, so if I choose to use them with my photos, I'll end up taping them in place.
